help_what_desc: External Trade allows buying products from outside the network and selling products abroad. It is the only part of the system that handles REAL money (USD, EUR, COP, etc.).
help_account_desc: External Trade has its own account in {{currency}} (like an organization). The Assembly transfers {{currency}} to it so it can buy outside. To fund the DEX, create a "Fund External Trade" proposal in the Assembly.
help_bank_accounts_desc: The DEX has accounts in real banks or in cash (vault). Each account has a currency (USD, EUR, COP...) and a balance. When buying outside, it's deducted from the bank. When selling outside, it's added to the bank.
help_purchases_desc: It registers what product was bought, how much, at what price in external currency, and which bank the money came from. The system calculates the suggested internal price using the FC.
help_sales_desc: It registers what product was sold, how much, at what price, and which bank the money went to.
help_fc_desc: Relationship between the external currency and the {{currency}}. It is calculated by comparing the cost of the basic basket there and here. After real purchases, the system suggests an FC recalculation based on the real prices paid.
help_board_desc: The DEX may require multi-signature to approve purchases/sales (e.g: 2 signatures). It is configured in the Bank Accounts tab.
tutorial_intro: The DEX is the External Trade department of the community. Its function is to connect the internal economy (TQ) with the external economy (real money: USD, EUR, COP, etc.).
tutorial_flow_1: Internal producer sells to DEX: A community producer sells their product to the External Trade department. The DEX pays them in TQ (internal currency).
tutorial_flow_2: DEX sells abroad (Export): The DEX sells that product in the external market and receives real money (USD, EUR, etc.) in an external bank account.
tutorial_flow_3: DEX buys abroad (Import): With that real money, the DEX buys the products the community needs but doesn't produce (medicines, tools, supplies, etc.).
tutorial_flow_4: DEX sells internally: The DEX brings those products and sells them within the community in TQ. Members can buy them with their internal balance.
tutorial_flow_5: The cycle repeats: The money from internal sales is used to buy more products from producers, and so the cycle continues.
tutorial_double_1: External bank accounts: Reflect the REAL money available (USD, EUR, COP). They update with each external purchase and exits.
tutorial_double_2: DEX TQ balance: Reflects the department's internal debt/credit. When it buys products from a producer, it pays in TQ. When it sells products internally, it receives TQ.
tutorial_fc_desc: The FC is the exchange rate between external currency and TQ. For example, if FC = 5, then 1 USD = 5 TQ. The FC is calculated by comparing the cost of a basic basket in external currency vs in local TQ. The suggested FC is automatically recalculated from registered real purchases.
tutorial_approvals_desc: External purchases and sales may require multiple approval (multi-signature). This means several authorized people must approve before money is moved. This prevents a single person from having total control over real money.
